description: This file contains React components and hooks for the authentication views of the Notesnook web application, including login, signup, MFA, session expiry, and account recovery screens.

methods.name: getRouteComponent
methods.description: Returns the React component corresponding to a given authentication route.

methods.name: Auth
methods.description: Main component rendering the authentication container and routing logic.

methods.name: HeadlessAuth
methods.description: Handles the internal routing and state management for auth views.

methods.name: AuthForm
methods.description: Reusable form component for various auth steps, handling submission, errors, and loading states.

methods.name: AuthField
methods.description: Input field component for auth forms.

methods.name: SubmitButton
methods.description: Button component for submitting auth forms.
